name: Corn
overview: Scripture presents corn as a vital agricultural product, notably in Egypt and Palestine, symbolizing provision and abundance as seen in Joseph's gathering of corn during seven plentiful years (Genesis 41:47-49). The Mosaic laws regulate the treatment of corn, emphasizing respect for a neighbor's standing grain and responsibility for damages caused by fire (Exodus 22:6; Deuteronomy 23:25). Corn also carries symbolic and figurative significance, illustrated by the plucking of ears by Christ's disciples and references to burnt shocks, underscoring themes of sustenance and divine order.
